raw_caption: On October 02, 2026, Shakarganj Foundation in collaboration with Cell Pharma organized a successful Free General Medical Camp at Mobile Free Dispensary Dera Ghulam Shabeer Kot Lakhnana.Dr Asim Qayyum examined 50 patients. All patients received free-of-cost medications from medical camp. Shakarganj Foundation extends its heartfelt gratitude to the Management of Cell Pharma for conducting the Free General Medical Camp at Mobile Free Dispensary Dera Shabeer Kot Lakhnana۔
